facts.label: New recipes
facts.value: Blizzard says Forever adds more than 600 new recipes across professions and level ranges.

facts.label: Gear only you can make
facts.value: Blacksmiths can make Bind on Pickup gear for themselves that no other crafter can supply, such as Sentinel's Sabatons.

facts.label: Camp objects
facts.value: Sharpening Wheel at skill 20, Anvil at 140 (blueprint from Gilnid in the Deadmines) and Master Forge at 300.

facts.label: Skill ranks
facts.value: Apprentice up to 75, Journeyman up to 150 (skill 50, level 10), Expert up to 225 (skill 125, level 20) and Artisan up to 300 (skill 200, level 35). 300 is the cap.

facts.label: Specialization (Classic baseline)
facts.value: Classic 1.12: choose Armorsmith or Weaponsmith, and a Weaponsmith can go on to become an Axe, Sword or Hammer master.
facts.note: Forever guides list the same paths.

facts.label: Merchant's Favor
facts.value: Favor recipes come from the Azeroth Commerce Authority at Three Corners in western Redridge, paid with Merchant's Favor from sealed Waylaid Crates.

facts.label: Legacy
facts.value: The first time you reach 150, 225 and 300 in a craft you earn 1 Legacy point each. Working Overtime improves your skill-up chance, and Dedicated Study gives a daily skill-up.

facts.label: Weapon stones
facts.value: Blacksmiths still make Dense Sharpening Stones, Dense Weightstones and Elemental Sharpening Stones for melee. Warcraft Tavern says stones now stack with poisons, Windfury Weapon and Windfury Totem.
facts.note: The stacking claim has one source and is unconfirmed.

facts.label: Sharpening Wheel buff
facts.value: Beta guides say the Sharpening Wheel gives Strength, like Strength of Earth Totem; Blizzard's recap said Attack Power. Either way it does not stack with the matching class buff.

facts.label: Not known yet
facts.note: Where the Master Forge blueprint drops.

facts.label: Not known yet
facts.note: Whether the Armorsmith and Weaponsmith quests are unchanged from Classic.

facts.label: Not known yet
facts.note: Whether the skill cap rises above 300 later. The Summer 2027 roadmap window mentions profession updates without details.

facts.label: Not known yet
facts.note: Whether Blacksmithing gets belt buckles or a Repair All ability; both appear only in unverified perk lists.

facts.label: Professions window
facts.value: Professions have their own window, opened with K. Recipe lists can be searched and filtered, and you can track a recipe in the objectives frame.

facts.label: Camp buffs
facts.value: Profession camp objects give weaker copies of class buffs that do not stack with the real ones. You sit at the camp for at least 1 minute to get them.

facts.label: Campsite size
facts.value: A basic campsite holds 3 camp features, one per player. Cooking upgrades raise this to 5 or 10.

facts.label: Earning Merchant's Favor
facts.value: Fill Waylaid Crates (found in the world or bought on the Auction House) and hand the sealed crates to Marcy Baker of the Azeroth Commerce Authority at Three Corners in western Redridge. Craftsman's Writs add reputation.

facts.label: Profession title
facts.value: Crafters who reach 300 can earn a certification item that unlocks a profession title. Alliance players get it from the Azeroth Commerce Authority.

facts.label: Vendor prices
facts.value: Blizzard's beta notes say many profession-made items sell to vendors for less.
facts.gameBuild: WoW: Forever (Blizzard beta notes of 16 Oct 2026)

facts.label: Stones with poisons
facts.value: Poisons can now be applied alongside sharpening stones or weightstones.

facts.label: Stones with Shaman imbues
facts.value: Shaman weapon imbues stack with sharpening stones and weightstones.

facts.label: Stones in Druid forms
facts.value: Sharpening stones work while a Druid is in form.
